fields.name: 1ed7df4b-e6d4-484e-92c3-4a5f5e07fd0c
fields.ourAnswer: I am a fullstack engineer with 8 years of experience building scalable web applications and developer tools. I'm drawn to Linear's mission of creating the best issue tracking platform because I deeply understand the pain points of engineering teams. My background spans both frontend and backend development, with a focus on performance, user experience, and developer ergonomics—qualities that align with Linear's product philosophy. I'm excited to contribute to a product used by thousands of teams and help shape the future of how engineers collaborate.

fields.label: What would you want to work on? Tell us about the features you would want to implement in your first month.
fields.name: 7d3da580-9e6d-494f-a63b-0a889e0a157a
fields.ourAnswer: I'm particularly interested in working on performance optimization and developer experience improvements. In my first month, I'd focus on: (1) identifying and addressing bottlenecks in the issue tracking workflow to reduce latency, (2) enhancing the real-time collaboration features to handle concurrent edits more seamlessly, (3) improving the API's query efficiency for complex filtering operations, and (4) refactoring core frontend components for better maintainability. I'd also prioritize understanding Linear's architecture deeply and collaborating with the team to identify high-impact features that align with the product roadmap.
